messages:
Elena: Quick weekly from me — three tactical asks to close before EOW: 1) Finalize EU Private beta launch (target Wed 03:00–07:00 UTC). 2) SLA uplift plan — aim for 99.9% for Dedicated (GPU/PU) by end of Q2. 3) Data retention & exports policy update — Legal is OK with default 90d; customers can opt into 1y. Need owners + short status updates by Friday EOD. TL;DR: launch schedule + SLA + retention. Thanks team. :rocket:

Raj: For the EU Private launch — can we confirm geo routing + fallback policy? We'll want a 5% canary for 48h. Also what's the rollback criteria? @Marco

Marco: Staging soak 72h -> canary 5% for 48h. Rollback triggers: >1% error rate sustained for 15m OR sustained latency P50 >5x baseline. I'll upload the runbook to #release-war-room. 👍

Priya: Product prefers a soft-open with ~10 pilot customers first. Can we make the SLA effective date +2 weeks after launch to allow tuning?

Elena: Soft-open +2w SLA effective date approved. Owners: Raj (launch infra), Marco (SRE/runbook), Priya (customer selection & comms), Ava (finance/cost). Please update status in this thread.

Ava: Noted. Quick cost flag — incremental for dedicated EU nodes looks ~+$28k/mo at ~70% util. I'll post a short breakdown in Confluence and ping finance.

deploy-bot: scheduled maintenance created for the EU private launch slot Wed 03:00 UTC — https://deploys.internal/2712345678

Raj: I'll create the canary + routing config today. Expect PR by EOD.

Marco: Runbook posted: https://playbooks.internal/reliability/eu-private-launch — contains monitors, run commands, and rollback steps.

Priya: DMing the pilot customer shortlist now. Also prepping a customer-facing note about retention defaults & export options (short blurb + FAQ).

Elena: Final ask — any blockers we should elevate? If none, I'll take this for exec sign-off Tue morning. Thanks, team :raised_hands:

Tim: small blocker — certs for EU region need expedite from NetOps, currently pending.

NetOps: Certs ordered, ETA ~18h, will update this thread when issued.

Elena: Awesome — keep updates here and flag anything that needs exec help.
